title: Chapter 56 — Displacing the Incumbent
intro: The displacement doctrine, the five wedges, and the patient campaign.

sections.title: Patience Wins Displacement
sections.content:
Most trade buyers already have a supplier. Displacing them requires patience, not aggression. Find the wedge — where the incumbent is weak. Lead times too long? Service inconsistent? Product knowledge lacking? Pricing not competitive?

Start with a small project. Prove yourself. Then grow. Displacement happens one project at a time, not one pitch at a time.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating displacement strategy, ask:

Has the salesperson identified where the incumbent is weak?
Are they positioning for a trial project — or trying to win the whole account immediately?
Are they patient — or pushing too hard too fast?
